name: Esparreguera (Spain)
description: Yellow field with five dark green pales at the centre, over which lies a white saltire.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 10 June 2005; it is based on the municipal arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with five dark green pales each 1/27 of the length at the centre and a white saltire of arms 14/27 of the length and 2/27 thick over them.

features.role: five pales each 1/27 of the length
saltire 14/27 of the length on each arm, 2/27 thick
